name: word_insert_markdown
description: Write Markdown as blocks in the document's styles: headings, lists, tables (empty header row: none), links, footnotes, images ![alt](b1), captions (: text). Returns the new blocks' ids.

from.description: Or rows of d:<id> or t:<table> as a table; one text field (d:<id>/#12/<col>) as Markdown.

from_columns.description: from's columns, in order. Default all.

header.description: from's header texts; [] none. Default column names.

date_format.description: Dates of from as e.g. d mmmm yyyy or dd/mm/yyyy.

style_map.description: Styles differing from the defaults (h1 Heading 1, paragraph Normal...).

style.description: The document's style name for it.

like.description: Paragraphs list items look like, by level; a table: its frame, empty cells joining merges.

key.description: Retry key: a repeat with the same key makes nothing new.

ref.description: Ref name for the new blocks ($name).
